//Kestrel: HTTPS by default, on every address of the server so the laboratory's computers reach it; the network filter below answers 403 to anything outside the local network. Without a certificate configured here, the ASP.NET Core development certificate is used (dotnet dev-certs https): enough for a test, not for a laboratory — the installer will set the server's own certificate (Certificate: Path/Password, or Subject/Store).

Kestrel.//EndpointDefaults: HTTP/1.1 only: a screen talks to the server over one WebSocket per tab, which gains nothing from HTTP/2; and over HTTP/2, Chromium was seen failing some of the menu's icon loads (ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES) on the page reached after the forced password change.

Database.//: The same database as the workstations: copy the ConnectionString of their appsettings.json. The account the service runs as must be able to sign in to SQL Server with it.

Application.//: As the workstations': the language the sign-in page opens in, and the demonstration data (leave it false in production; see the workstation's appsettings.json).

Web.//AllowedNetworks: The only addresses served: the loopback, the private ranges of IPv4 and IPv6, the link-local ones, and 100.64.0.0/10 for a Tailscale-type VPN. Every other address is answered 403. Narrow it to the laboratory's own subnets if they are known.
Web.//InitializeDatabase: Creates or migrates the database and seeds the first administrator at start-up, as each workstation does. Turn it off when the server's Windows application is the one to do it.
Web.//MigrationProfilesFolder: Where « Reprise de données » keeps its profiles on the server. Left empty: the service account's LocalApplicationData\MarocLIS\Web\Reprise\Profils.

Instruments.//: Keep identical to the workstations': the account analyser results are attributed to when a transmission is replayed from the web, and how long the message log is kept. The web never drives an analyser: EnableInstrumentHost is not read here.

PasswordPolicy.//: Keep identical to the workstations' appsettings.json: the lockout counts and the idle timeout (the web session's automatic sign-out) are one policy.

Reporting.//: Keep identical to the workstations': a document printed from the web is the same document. See src/MarocLIS.Reporting/LICENSING.md before setting the licence.
